name: Everything at Once
description: Any final blow or finisher refills every ability, drops Orbs of Light, reloads, adds rounds, explodes the target with Firefly's blast and a burst of suppressing Void energy, sends a concussive blast and a burst of chaining Arc energy out from you, cloaks you and grants Truesight for 20 seconds, summons an Arc Soul and grants Devour. Carries an extra grenade, melee and class ability charge.

program.name: Vanish, Truesight, Arc Soul, Devour and Blasts
